description: STEP 4: recognise a nested sub-frame by a BASIS CHANGE (locus motion collinear with no parent axis) and mint a child WorldBinding (filled_by). Child-frame discovery reuses the authored principal_axes; value rolls up via world_understanding rollup_value. Held Terms only; no new primitive.

microtheory.name: nested_frame
microtheory.description: frames nest: a locus whose motion opens a new basis is a child world; recognised by basis-change, discovered by principal_axes, value rolled up

rules.name: detect_nested_frame
rules.comment: basis-change detector: a locus whose sub-context discovers MORE axes than the parent frame (a direction outside the parent's span) is a nested sub-frame -> mint a child WorldBinding (filled_by). Both N's come from the authored principal_axes; this is a scalar comparison. Single-fire via has_child.
